name: google-analytics
description: Google Analytics 4 guardrails: the overloaded vocabulary, the mistakes models typically make, why numbers differ between reports, the Data API and BigQuery, and Data Manager - with links to Google's docs for the rest. Adds cost-controlled querying of the GA4 BigQuery export, bundles Google's read-only Analytics MCP server and supports the ga CLI for configuration changes

google_application_credentials.title: Google credentials file
google_application_credentials.description: Path to an Application Default Credentials or service account JSON file with the analytics.readonly scope

google_cloud_project.title: Google Cloud project ID
google_cloud_project.description: Project used for API quota and billing; the Analytics Data and Admin APIs must be enabled in it
